thornwatch_forge.name: Gwen's Forge
thornwatch_forge.greet: Mind the sparks. If it's bent I'll straighten it, if it's sharp I'll sell it.

thornwatch_herbs.name: The Sisters' Remedies
thornwatch_herbs.greet: Mother Isolde mixes them, I only count the jars. Two drops on the tongue, not the whole flask.

thornwatch_peddler.name: Fennick's Wagon
thornwatch_peddler.greet: Everything a hero needs and a few things a hero only thinks they need. Prices are fair. Fairly fair.

proshop.name: Saltmere Links Pro Shop
proshop.greet: Welcome to the Links. You need a set of clubs to play: start with the Starter Set, and come back for a better one when your game asks for it.
